description: Implementation of TraceLogger class for logging diagnostic events related to graphing and calculations in the GraphControl namespace.

classes.name: TraceLogger
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for logging diagnostic events such as equation count changes, function analysis, variable count, and line width changes.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TraceLogger.

methods.name: LogEquationCountChanged
methods.description: Logs changes in the count of valid and invalid equations, updating total counts accordingly.

methods.name: LogFunctionAnalysisPerformed
methods.description: Logs the result of a function analysis, including error type and complexity flags.

methods.name: LogVariableCountChanged
methods.description: Logs changes in the number of variables.

methods.name: LogLineWidthChanged
methods.description: Logs changes in line width settings.
